best_idea: Let the player pay for an unlock in instalments from whatever the ledger holds, keep the partial progress, and unlock only when the whole cost is paid, with the parent unlocking along with it.
decision_why: Instalment payment, all-or-nothing unlock and the objective gate are a good progression shape, but Frankendom must keep progress on the server ledger (the donor saves it to client settings), decide the ancestor-unlock rule explicitly, and disable spending when nothing can be paid.
acceptance: A server test: an unlock needing 40 of an item with 25 held moves 25 from the ledger, shows 62 percent and stays locked; the next grant of 15 completes it, unlocks its parent, and leaves the ledger at zero for that item; a spend with an empty ledger changes nothing and is refused.
